id: 2a4c6e80-3b5d-4f71-9a2c-7d8e9f0a1b23
status: experimental
description: Detects schtasks importing a task XML from C:\Users\Public\Documents\<5char>\<5char>.xml, the CryptoBandits worm/stealer persistence pattern.
references:
    - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/06/17/crypto-clipper-uses-tor-worm-like-propagation-for-persistence-control/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1053.005
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - '/create'
            - '/xml'
        CommandLine|re: '(?i)\\Users\\Public\\Documents\\[a-z]{4,6}\\[a-z]{4,6}\.xml'
    condition: selection
level: high
2812.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="schtasks.exe" Processes.process="*/create*" Processes.process="*/xml*" Processes.process="*\\Users\\Public\\Documents\\*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | regex process="(?i)\\Users\\Public\\Documents\\[a-z]{4,6}\\[a-z]{4,6}\.xml" | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2812.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\schtasks\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/\/create/i
| CommandLine=/\/xml/i
| CommandLine=/\\Users\\Public\\Documents\\[a-z]{4,6}\\[a-z]{4,6}\.xml/i
| table([_time, aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine])

title: External DTD or XSLT Stylesheet Fetch (Blind XXE / SSRF - CVE-2026-55471)
id: 7b9c1f2a-3d4e-4a5b-8c6d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: An outbound HTTP request to a URL ending in .dtd/.xsl/.xslt, the resolution side-effect of an unhardened Saxon TransformerFactory in HAPI FHIR org.hl7.fhir.utilities.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2f55-g35j-5jmf
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1071.001
logsource:
  category: proxy

      - 'xsl'
      - 'xslt'

      - 'oasis-open.org'
      - 'docbook.org'

title: Long-label DNS Query from Java Process (XXE Parameter-Entity OOB Exfil - CVE-2026-55471)
id: 2c3d4e5f-6a7b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: A DNS query from a Java process whose leftmost label is abnormally long, characteristic of XXE parameter-entity out-of-band exfiltration smuggling file contents into a subdomain.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2f55-g35j-5jmf
author: SOC Detection Engineering

tags:
  - attack.t1071.004
  - attack.t1041

  category: dns
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\java.exe'
  selection_query:
    query|re: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{30,}\.'
  condition: selection_img and selection_query
falsepositives:
  - CDN / cloud telemetry hostnames with long hashed labels

level: medium

2862.sent:
let Window = 10m;   // attacker probes auth then bypasses within minutes
let Failures = ImWebSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Url has "/v1/"
    | where HttpStatusCode in (401, 403)
    | project FailTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, FailUrl = Url, DstHostname;
let Success = ImWebSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Url has "/v1/"
    | where HttpStatusCode in (200, 201)
    | project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, SuccessUrl = Url, SuccessHost = HttpHostName, DstHostname;
Failures
| join kind=inner Success on SrcIpAddr
| where SuccessTime between (FailTime .. FailTime + Window)
| project FailTime, SuccessTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', SuccessTime, FailTime),
          SrcIpAddr, FailUrl, SuccessUrl, SuccessHost, DstHostname
| order by SuccessTime desc
2862.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) as failTime from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.url="*/v1/*" (Web.status=401 OR Web.status=403) by Web.src
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| join type=inner src
    [| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) as successTime from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.url="*/v1/*" (Web.status=200 OR Web.status=201) by Web.src
     | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`]
| where successTime > failTime AND successTime <= failTime + 600
| eval delaySec = successTime - failTime
| convert ctime(failTime) ctime(successTime)
| table failTime, successTime, delaySec, src
| sort - successTime

description: Detects CloudTrail management API calls that stop, delete or reconfigure a trail (StopLogging/DeleteTrail/UpdateTrail/PutEventSelectors), blinding cloud visibility.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cloud-logging-defense-evasion/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/008/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/26
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.008
logsource:
  product: aws
  service: cloudtrail
detection:
  selection:
    eventSource: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
    eventName:
      - StopLogging
      - DeleteTrail
      - UpdateTrail
      - PutEventSelectors
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Authorized infrastructure-as-code changes to trail configuration
  - Decommissioning of an account or region
level: high
2928.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Change where (All_Changes.command IN ("StopLogging","DeleteTrail","UpdateTrail","PutEventSelectors")) AND All_Changes.status="success" by All_Changes.user All_Changes.command All_Changes.object All_Changes.src All_Changes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
2928.datadog: source:cloudtrail @evt.name:(StopLogging OR DeleteTrail OR UpdateTrail OR PutEventSelectors) @evt.outcome:success
2928.cloudwatch:
# log group: /aws/cloudtrail
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.type, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters.name, awsRegion
| filter eventSource = "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"
      and eventName in ["StopLogging", "DeleteTrail", "UpdateTrail", "PutEventSelectors"]
      and not isPresent(errorCode)
| sort @timestamp desc

2929.sigma:
title: AWS S3 Deletion of CloudTrail Log Storage Bucket
id: 8a1b2c3d-4e5f-4061-9b2c-7d8e9f0a1b2c
description: Detects DeleteBucket/DeleteObject(s) against an S3 bucket whose name indicates it stores CloudTrail/audit logs, destroying the log destination.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cloud-logging-defense-evasion/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/008/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/26
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1562.008
  - attack.t1485
logsource:
  product: aws
  service: cloudtrail
detection:
  selection:
    eventSource: s3.amazonaws.com
    eventName:
      - DeleteBucket
      - DeleteObject
      - DeleteObjects
  bucket_scope:
    requestParameters.bucketName|contains:
      - cloudtrail
      - log
      - audit
      - trail
  condition: selection and bucket_scope
falsepositives:
  - Lifecycle cleanup of expired log buckets by platform team
level: high
2929.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Change where (All_Changes.command IN ("DeleteBucket","DeleteObject","DeleteObjects")) AND All_Changes.status="success" AND (All_Changes.object IN ("*cloudtrail*","*log*","*audit*","*trail*")) by All_Changes.user All_Changes.command All_Changes.object All_Changes.src | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
2929.datadog: source:cloudtrail @evt.name:(DeleteBucket OR DeleteObject OR DeleteObjects) @requestParameters.bucketName:(*cloudtrail* OR *log* OR *audit* OR *trail*) @evt.outcome:success
2929.cloudwatch:
# log group: /aws/cloudtrail
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters.bucketName, awsRegion
| filter eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com"
      and eventName in ["DeleteBucket", "DeleteObject", "DeleteObjects"]

2931.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-8467: PhoenixStorybook: Unauthenticated remote code e
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("system.cmd"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("system.cmd"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2931.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-8467: PhoenixStorybook: Unauthenticated remote code e ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("system.cmd"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("system.cmd"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

status: experimental
description: Detects successful POST to nebula-mesh /api/v1/operators/{id}/api-keys, which on versions < 0.3.4 lacks admin/ownership checks (CVE-2026-47724) and lets any operator key mint a fresh bearer for any operator including admins.
references:

author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:

  - attack.t1190

logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-method: POST
    cs-uri-stem|re: '^/api/v1/operators/[^/]+/api-keys/?$'
    sc-status:
      - 200
      - 201
  condition: selection
falsepositives:

  - Automated key rotation scripts owned by the ops team

let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 60;
let Reenroll = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where csMethod == "POST"
    | where csUriStem matches regex @"^/api/v1/hosts/[^/]+/reenroll/?$"
    | where scStatus in (200, 201)
    | extend VictimHostId = extract(@"/api/v1/hosts/([^/]+)/reenroll", 1, csUriStem)
    | project ReenrollTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, cIP, csUserName, VictimHostId, ReenrollAgent = csUserAgent;
let Enroll = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where csMethod == "POST"
    | where csUriStem matches regex @"^/api/v1/enroll/?$"
    | where scStatus in (200, 201)
    | project EnrollTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, cIP, EnrollAgent = csUserAgent;
Reenroll
| join kind=inner Enroll on cIP, Computer
| where EnrollTime between (ReenrollTime .. ReenrollTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EnrollTime, ReenrollTime)
| extend CVE = "CVE-2026-47724"
| project ReenrollTime, EnrollTime, DelaySec, Computer, cIP, csUserName, VictimHostId, ReenrollAgent, EnrollAgent, CVE
| order by ReenrollTime desc

| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| rex field=uri_path "/api/v1/hosts/(?<victim_host_id>[^/]+)/reenroll"
| eval reenroll_time=_time, reenroll_count=count
| fields - count
| join type=inner src dest [

    | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
    | eval enroll_time=_time

  ]
| where enroll_time >= reenroll_time AND enroll_time <= reenroll_time + 60
| eval delay_sec=enroll_time - reenroll_time, cve="CVE-2026-47724"
| stats min(reenroll_time) as first_reenroll values(victim_host_id) as victim_hosts min(delay_sec) as min_delay_sec max(delay_sec) as max_delay_sec count by src user dest cve
| where count >= 1
| sort - first_reenroll

2998.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Node-gyp Supply Chain Compromise: A Self-Propagating npm Worm That Hides in bind
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("index.js", "node.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/dev/null") or FileName in~ ("index.js", "node.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
